ads_ratio.reason: One ADS represents one ordinary share, so per-share figures in EUR-converted USD and the ADS price are on the same 1:1 basis; no scaling applies.
ads_ratio.source: Form 20-F/A for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, cover page (SEC filing, CIK 1776985): securities registered under Section 12(b) are 'American Depositary Shares, each Representing one ordinary share', trading symbol BNTX on Nasdaq

moat_against: COVID-19 vaccine demand collapsing: Q2 2026 revenue -59.5% YoY and FY2026 guidance cut to €1.6-1.9B
No approved oncology product yet: pipeline value is binary clinical/regulatory risk, not a commercial moat
COVID economics shared with Pfizer; competition from Moderna and other vaccine/oncology platforms
Founder/CEO leadership transition (incoming CEO by Feb 1, 2027) and heavy R&D/SG&A burn widening losses
moat_for: Proven mRNA platform and manufacturing that delivered a commercial COVID-19 vaccine at global scale with Pfizer
Large cash and security investments balance funding years of oncology R&D without dilution
BMS collaboration on pumitamig and a broad late-stage oncology pipeline (14 pivotal trials in Q2 2026 reporting)
Deep mRNA / immunotherapy know-how and CureVac acquisition consolidating mRNA IP
moat_justification: Proven mRNA platform, manufacturing know-how and the Pfizer COVID-19 partnership, funded by a very large cash and investments balance, but no durable commercial franchise beyond the shrinking COVID vaccine: oncology pipeline (pumitamig/BMS, ADCs, mRNA immunotherapies) is unapproved and binary, the COVID economics are shared with Pfizer and commoditising, and leadership is in transition.
name: BioNTech SE
one_liner: Proven mRNA platform, moat 4/10, huge cash pile funding an unapproved oncology pivot — but current owner's earnings do not support the price: weighted IRR 3.19%, weighted IV@15 $5.27 vs $88.77; clears 15% only below ~$5.27 on this OE base.
